title: Amtrak passes 18 append-only audit-chain integrity cases
summary: Every Amtrak chain accepts ordered appends and rejects payload mutation, event replacement, time regression, and duplicate identifiers while preserving superseded receipts. Denominator: 18 fixture-only audit cases across 2 contracts; zero failures and zero actual audit events.
